status: local-only; lexical signals are not authorization for replay or application
canonical_line_format: <sha256><two spaces><path><LF>, paths sorted bytewise by filename
analysis_caveat: Comment-like sequences are removed lexically without a string-aware parser; function bodies and remaining string literals stay in scope. Normalized hashes and effect, dependency, precondition, destructive and compensation fields are conservative comparison signals, not a PostgreSQL parse, semantic equivalence or proof of runtime behavior.
